description: Millions of children. Five critical challenges. One opportunity to build what comes next. India has one of the world’s largest school systems, but millions of children still struggle to build foundational reading and maths skills. In rural India, ASER 2024 finds that only around 7 in 10 Grade 3 children can’t read a Grade 2-level text, while roughly 2 in 3 cannot do basic subtraction. Teachers and education systems also face everyday constraints, from multi-grade classrooms to limited time and data utilization to support every learner. AI is transforming what technology can do but its potential to solve India’s toughest education challenges remains largely untapped. Now is the time to put that power to work on five critical foundational learning challenges, identified and prioritised by leading organisations focussing on education in India. Using real problems, real resources and frontier AI, this hackathon challenges innovators to turn bold ideas into working solutions. The challenge is yours to solve. Over a span of 10 weeks, turn an ambitious idea into a working prototype that could help strengthen foundational learning for children from low-income communities, and discover what AI can make possible in the Indian classroom.
